study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Maternal serum lipid parameters (total cholesterol, LDL-C, HDL-C, triglycerides)
Maximum oxytocin infusion dose (high vs. low)
cohort: Women who presented for delivery at ≥37 weeks' gestation and received oxytocin during labor
finding: The study found that low maternal HDL-C levels at term were associated with higher maximum oxytocin infusion doses, particularly among women undergoing labor induction or augmentation.
mod_finding: Lower maternal high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C) levels at term are associated with higher maximum oxytocin infusion doses among women undergoing labor induction or augmentation.
